z-m-08-04.title: Zvinyorwa zvokusvetuka kwakakwira: ndiani akasvetuka zvakakwira?
z-m-08-04.topic: Kuenzanisa nhamba ine nhamba imwe shure kwepoinzi redhesimari nenhamba ine nhamba nhatu
z-m-08-04.goal: Enzanisa madhesimari nokukosha kwenzvimbo panzvimbo penhamba yemavara, tarisa kutonga kwako sezvo data itsva ichiuya, uye gadzira muenzaniso wako unopesana nomutemo wakanganisa.
z-m-08-04.material: Pamutambo wemitambo wechikoro wokusvetuka kwakakwira, zvinyorwa zvaSeoyun naDohyeon zvakayerwa. Chinyorwa ihurefu mumamita (m) kubva pasi kusvika pabhawa, hwakayerwa netepi. Zvinyorwa zvinopiwa kwauri chinhanho chimwe panguva imwe.
z-m-08-04.thinking.0: Kutarisa kutonga kwako sezvo data ichiwedzerwa
z-m-08-04.prereq.0: Kuverenga nokunyora madhesimari ane nzvimbo imwe, mbiri, nenhatu shure kwepoinzi redhesimari
z-m-08-04.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa data imwe chete panguva imwe, tonga kuti ndiani akasvetuka zvakakwira, uye utarise kutonga kwako kana data itsva ichiuya.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.0: Pachinhanho chega chega, tonga uchishandisa chete zvaunoziva kusvikira zvino, uye tanga wanyora nemashoko kuti kutonga kwako kunochinja here kana data itsva ichiuya.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja zvinyorwa zviviri kuva chikamu chimwe chete uzvienzanise padivi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Chinyorwa chaSeoyun ndi 1.4 m uye chinyorwa chaDohyeon ndi 1.38 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kutonga kwokuti Seoyun akakwira uye kutonga kwokuti kwachangotanga kuti utonge zvose zvine musoro pachinhanho chino. Unogona kutonga nokutanga waenzanisa nzvimbo dzetenths.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kungava kutonga kwakatarisa kukosha kwenzvimbo dzetenths nehundredths.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Dohyeon akasvetuka zvakakwira, nokuti 38 yakakura pa 4
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaverenga nhamba dziri shure kwepoinzi redhesimari senhamba yose woenzanisa 38 ne 4. Nemadhesimari, unofanira kutanga watarisa kuti nhamba yega yega iri panzvimbo ipi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kubvuma nokutendeseka kuti hauna chokwadi uye kumirira data inotevera zvinewo musoro.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Tepi inemamaki makuru anoparadzanisa chikamu chiri pamusoro pe 1 m kuva nzvimbo 10, uye kana nzvimbo imwe neimwe yaparadzaniswa zvakare kuva 10, pane nzvimbo 100 dzose. 1.4 m yaSeoyun ine nzvimbo 4 pamusoro pe 1 m pamamaki makuru. 1.38 m yaDohyeon ine nzvimbo 38 pamusoro pe 1 m pamamaki enzvimbo 100.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino wanyatsoona data yechiyero, unofunga kuti ndiani akakwira?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 1.4 m yakaenzana ne 1.40 m, saka ndezvikamu 40. Kunyange nenhamba shoma, nhamba inogona kuva yakakura nokuda kwokukosha kwenzvimbo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Pachiyero chezvikamu 100, 1.4 ndezvikamu 40, saka iri pamusoro pezvikamu 38.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tarisazve pachiyero kuti nhamba 38 iri pasi pe 40.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Zvinyorwa zvose zviri pachiyero, saka unogona kutonga nedata iyi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Harin akasvetukawo. Chinyorwa chaHarin ndi 1.405 m. Uye 1.4 m yaSeoyun ihurefu hwakafanana kunyange ukainyora se 1.40 m kana 1.400 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ndeipi inoronga zvinyorwa zvitatu kubva pakakwira kusvika padiki?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 1.405 iri 0.005 pamusoro pe 1.400. Saka kurongeka ndi Harin, Seoyun, Dohyeon. Kurongeka kwaSeoyun naDohyeon hakuna kuchinja data itsva painouya.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku ndiko kurongeka kunowanikwa nokufunga kuti ane manhamba akawanda ndiye mukuru. Nyora 1.4 se 1.400 woenzanisa kutanga nenzvimbo yetenths.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 1.405 ne 1.4 (= 1.400) zvinotanga kusiyana panzvimbo yethousandths, uye 1.38 inosiyana panzvimbo yehundredths.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Seoyun naHarin vakafanana, uye Dohyeon ndiye mudiki
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakaregeredza 5 iri pakupera kwa 1.405. 1.400 ne 1.405 inhamba dzakasiyana.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.reflect: Kunyange data itsva painouya, kutonga kwokuti Seoyun akasvetuka zvakakwira kupfuura Dohyeon kwakaramba kwakafanana. Chakachinja kurongeka Harin paakawedzerwa. Madhesimari anoenzaniswa nokukosha kwenzvimbo yenhamba yega yega, kwete nehuwandu hwemavara.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari inoti, "Nhamba ine manhamba akawanda shure kwepoinzi redhesimari ndiyo nhamba huru." Uchishandisa madhesimari maviri matsva kunze kwe 1.4, 1.38, ne 1.405 yawakaona pamusoro, ratidza kuti kutaura uku kwakanganisa uye nyora kuti ndeipi yakakura.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funga madhesimari maviri ane manhamba etenths akasiyana.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora nhamba hombe kusvika pa hundredths place (uchiisa 0) uye uenzanise nhamba mbiri padivi pedivi.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mu decimals maviri awakapa, ine madhijiti akawanda i nhamba diki here?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga kuti kureba kumwechete kunogona kunyorwa nehuwandu hwakasiyana hwemadhijiti mushure me decimal point (1.4 = 1.40) here?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.0: Tarisa 0.5 ne 0.45. 0.45 ine madhijiti akawanda, asi 0.5 i 0.50, saka i hombe kupfuura 0.45.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.1: Pane 2.3 ne 2.27. 2.27 ine madhijiti akawanda, asi 2.3 i 2.30, saka 2.3 i hombe.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.2: Tarisa 0.9 ne 0.89. 0.89 ine madhijiti maviri mushure me decimal point, asi 0.9=0.90, saka 0.9 i hombe.

z-m-08-07.title: Nhamba yakagadzirwa nemakadhi maviri ine madhijiti mangani?
z-m-08-07.goal: Edza chirevo chakazara ne counterexamples, fungidzira zviitiko zvidiki zvikuru nezvikuru zvikuru, uye utaure range inogoneka yemhedzisiro pamwe chete nemamiriro.
z-m-08-07.material: Ngatigadzirei ma products nemakadhi enhamba. Dhonza kadhi rimwe ranhamba ine madhijiti matatu (100 kusvika 999) uye kadhi rimwe ranhamba ine madhijiti maviri (10 kusvika 99), uye uwanze nhamba mbiri. Minseo akati, "Kana ukawanza nhamba ine madhijiti matatu ne nhamba ine madhijiti maviri, unogara uchiwana nhamba ine madhijiti mashanu. Nekuti 3 + 2 = 5!"
z-m-08-07.thinking.0: Kusarudza mienzaniso inogona kuva ma counterexamples
z-m-08-07.thinking.1: Kugadzira nekutarisa iwe pachako zviitiko zvakati wandei
z-m-08-07.thinking.2: Kufungidzira range nekusvika pamhedziso ine mamiriro
z-m-08-07.prereq.0: Kuwanza nhamba ine madhijiti matatu ne nhamba ine madhijiti maviri nekufungidzira kana kuverenga (padanho regiredhi re4)
z-m-08-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mapeya ese emakadhi anogona kushandiswa kuratidza kuti chirevo chaMinseo chakaipa. Usati waverenga, tanga wafunga nekufungidzira.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.0: Pa peya imwe neimwe, shandura nhamba mbiri kuita zana kana gumi rakapoteredza uye ufungidzire hukuru hweproduct.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ronga sarudzo nekuti product i shoma kana kupfuura 10000 (zviuru gumi).
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.a: Fungidzira product yenhamba mbiri hombe zvikuru i chii. Product iyi ine madhijiti mangani?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.c: Gadzirisa kana 500 × 40 i muzviuru kana muzviuru gumi. Peya iyi inogona kutsemura chirevo chaMinseo here?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i product yemakadhi maviri madiki zvikuru.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.e: Fungidzira kana 120 × 50 i muzviuru kana muzviuru gumi.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.explain: Kutsemura chirevo chaMinseo, unoda peya ine product i nhamba ine madhijiti mana. 345 × 27 = 9315, 100 × 10 = 1000, ne 120 × 50 = 6000 zvose i nhamba dzine madhijiti mana. 999 × 99 = 98901 ne 500 × 40 = 20000 i nhamba dzine madhijiti mashanu, saka hadzipokani nechirevo chaMinseo.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.prompt: Edza chirevo chaMinseo. Sarudza nhamba ine madhijiti matatu a nenhamba ine madhijiti maviri b kugadzira peya imwe ine product i nhamba ine madhijiti mana uye peya imwe ine product i nhamba ine madhijiti mashanu. (Mapeya maviri anofanira kuva ne ma products ane huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakasiyana.)
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga kubva panhamba dzidiki uye tanga waverenga kuti product ine madhijiti mangani kunhamba sa 100 ne 10.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti ndeipi pa a ne b yaunofanira kuita hombe, uye nezvakadini, kuti product ipfuure 10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dziri pamakadhi i natural numbers.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c2: a inofanira kuva nhamba ine madhijiti matatu kubva ku 100 kusvika ku 999.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c3: b inofanira kuva nhamba ine madhijiti maviri kubva ku 10 kusvika ku 99.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, 345 × 27 = 9315 i nhamba ine madhijiti mana uye 500 × 40 = 20000 i nhamba ine madhijiti mashanu. 100 × 10 = 1000 ne 120 × 50 = 6000 i nhamba dzine madhijiti mana, uye 999 × 99 = 98901 ne 250 × 60 = 15000 i nhamba dzine madhijiti mashanu. Inoverengwa chete kana ma products maviri ane huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakasiyana.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.prompt: Unogona kutaura chii nezvehuwandu hwemadhijiti eproduct yenhamba ine madhijiti matatu nenhamba ine madhijiti maviri? Nyora chikonzero chako nekufungidzira kana kuverenga chiitiko chidiki zvikuru nechikuru zvikuru.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.0: Wanza nhamba idiki zvikuru ine madhijiti matatu nenhamba idiki zvikuru ine madhijiti maviri.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira product yenhamba mbiri hombe zvikuru nekuienzanisa ne 100 × 100.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakawana kuti product idiki zvikuru (100 × 10) neyakakura zvikuru (999 × 99) imwe neimwe ine madhijiti mangani here?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga kuti unogona kuziva sei kuti ma products ese ari pakati ane madhijiti mana kana mashanu here?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.0: I nhamba ine madhijiti mana kana madhijiti mashanu. Idiki zvikuru, 100 × 10 = 1000, i nhamba ine madhijiti mana, uye yakakura zvikuru, 999 × 99, i shoma kupfuura 100000 (zviuru zana), saka haiti nhamba ine madhijiti matanhatu. Pakati, inova madhijiti mashanu painopfuura 10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.1: Product inogona kuva nemadhijiti 4 kana 5. 345 × 27 = 9315 ine madhijiti mana, uye 500 × 40 = 20000 ine madhijiti mashanu. Haigone kuva shoma kupfuura 1000 uye haigone kupfuura zviuru zana.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.2: Product i nhamba ine madhijiti mana kana mashanu. Idiki zvikuru, 100×10=1000, ine madhijiti mana, uye yakakura zvikuru, 999×99, i shoma kupfuura zviuru zana, saka ine madhijiti mashanu pakanyanya.

z-m-08-02.title: Makadhi maviri anowedzera kusvika 90: zvibodzwa zvichaenzana here?
z-m-08-02.topic: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwezvigadzirwa zvenhamba mbiri dzine mavara maviri
z-m-08-02.goal: Ziva kuti muenzaniso mumwe hauisi chokwadi che "nguva dzose zvakafanana", gadzira mienzaniso yakasiyana inosangana nemamiriro, uienzanise, uye utsanangure zvinofanana mumapeya ane zvibodzwa zvikuru.
z-m-08-02.material: Ngatitambei mutambo wamakadhi enhamba. Kadhi rimwe nerimwe rine nhamba imwe yechisikigo kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 99 yakanyorwa. Mutemo: unosarudza makadhi maviri, uye nhamba mbiri dzinofanira kuwedzera kusvika pa 90 chaizvo. Chibodzwa ndicho nhamba mbiri dzakawanzwa pamwe chete. Sua akasarudza 40 ne 50 uye akawana mapoinzi 2000. Akabva ati, "Kana huwandu uri 90, chibodzwa nguva dzose chinova mapoinzi 2000!" Kurongeka kwaunoisa makadhi hakuna basa. (30 ne 60, ne 60 ne 30, ndipeya rimwe chete.)
z-m-08-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei mukati memamiriro
z-m-08-02.prereq.0: Kuwanza nhamba dzine mavara maviri nedzimwe (chiyero cheGredhi 4, pasina calculator)
z-m-08-02.prereq.1: Kuita mapeya enhamba dzechisikigo kuti ave nehuwandu hwakafanana
z-m-08-02.s.s1.prompt: Sua akataura asati aona mhedzisiro yepeya rimwe chete 40 ne 50. Mhedzisiro yepeya rimwe chete iyi inotiudza chii pamusoro pezvakataurwa naSua?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kutaura kwaSua kunosanganisira shoko rokuti "nguva dzose". Funga nezvechinhu chinokurumidza kuitwa kuti uone kana kutaura kuku kuri kwechokwadi.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira rimwe peya rine huwandu 90 utsvage chibodzwa charo.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.a: 40 ne 50 zvakapa mapoinzi 2000, saka peya rega rega rinopa mapoinzi 2000
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.a: Muenzaniso mumwe kuva wakarurama hauratidzi "nguva dzose". Ungaedza here mamwe mapeya zvakare?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.b: Hazvigoni kutongwa kusvikira tatarisa rimwe peya rine huwandu 90
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakaratidza kuti muenzaniso mumwe oga haugoni kutiudza "nguva dzose".
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.c: Tinogona kutonga izvozvi kuti zvibodzwa hazvienzani kunyange huwandu hwakafanana
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.c: Mhedzisiro yepeya rimwe oga haigoni kusimbisa "hazvienzani". Unofanira kugadzira chaizvo mamwe mapeya woaenzanisa.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.d: Hatinawo kuziva. Saka hatidi kutarisa rimwe peya
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakarurama kunzwa kuti hauzivi, asi kana usingazivi, kuedza ndicho chinhanho chinotevera.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.explain: 40 ne 50 kupa mapoinzi 2000 muenzaniso mumwe chete usingapesani nezvakataurwa naSua. Kuti uzive kana "kana huwandu uri 90, chibodzwa nguva dzose chakafanana" chiri chechokwadi, unofanira kutarisa mamwe mapeya ane huwandu 90. Kana rimwe peya ripa chibodzwa chakasiyana, peya iroro muenzaniso unopesana.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya matatu amakadhi ane mavara maviri ane huwandu 90 ane zvibodzwa zvakasiyana. (Kuchinjana makadhi maviri kunopa peya rimwe chete.)
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kadhi rokutanga, wobva wabvisa nhamba iyoyo pa 90 kuti ugadzire kadhi rechipiri.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja kadhi rokutanga, uchisvetuka kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 90, asi tarisa kuti nhamba mbiri dzose dzine mavara maviri.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Makadhi ane nhamba dzechisikigo chete dzakanyorwa.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Nhamba mbiri dzose dziri pakati pe 10 ne 99.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba dziri pamakadhi dzine mavara maviri kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 99.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwenhamba mbiri hausi 90. Dzivedzere kuti utarise.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.explain: Mapeya ane huwandu 90 ane zvibodzwa zvakasiyana, semuenzaniso (40, 50) = mapoinzi 2000, (30, 60) = mapoinzi 1800, (20, 70) = mapoinzi 1400, (45, 45) = mapoinzi 2025, ne (11, 79) = mapoinzi 869. Sezvo mamwe mapeya ane huwandu hwakafanana asi zvigadzirwa zvakasiyana, kutaura kwaSua hakusi kwechokwadi nguva dzose. Peya rakachinjana (50 ne 40) ndipeya rimwe chete, saka riverenge kamwe chete.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.prompt: Enzanisa zvibodzwa zvemapeya awakagadzira. Nhamba mbiri dzakanga dzakaita sei mupeya rine chibodzwa chikuru? Tsanangura nzira imwe yokusarudza makadhi kuti chibodzwa chive chikuru. Shandisa mapeya awakawana chaizvo semienzaniso.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvibodzwa zvemapeya awakagadzira nokurongeka kubva pakakura kusvika padiki, uye nyorawo musiyano pakati penhamba mbiri mupeya rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti nhamba mbiri dziri kure zvakadini mumapeya ane zvibodzwa zvikuru nomumapeya ane zvibodzwa zvidiki.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, peya rine chibodzwa chikuru raiva ...
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakawanza chaizvo kuti uwane zvibodzwa zvemienzaniso yako here?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unogona kuedza kamwe kamwe here kuti peya itsva yakasarudzwa nenzira yawakatsanangura chaizvo inowana chibodzwa chikuru?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.0: 40 ne 50 zvakapa mapoinzi 2000, 30 ne 60 zvakapa mapoinzi 1800, uye 20 ne 70 zvakapa mapoinzi 1400. Nhamba mbiri dzaiswedera, chibodzwa chaikura. Saka kana ndikasarudza nhamba dzine musiyano mudiki dzakaita se 45 ne 45, ndinofunga chichava chikuru zvakare.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.1: Musiyano pamupeya wakanga uchidiki, chibodzwa chaikura. Musiyano pakati pe 40 ne 50 ndi 10 uye chibodzwa ndi 2000, asi 20 ne 70 dzine musiyano we 50 uye dzinopa 1400. Kana huwandu uri 90, zvakanaka kusarudza nhamba dzakaswedera ne 45.

z-m-08-06.title: Kana ukabatanidza maribhoni maviri, anoita 4 m here?
z-m-08-06.topic: Kuwedzera nhamba dzine decimal places 2 nemayuniti ehurefu
z-m-08-06.goal: Tonga kana unogona kusvika pamhedziso kubva paruzivo rwakapiwa, taura kuti chii chimwe chaunofanira kuziva, uye utaure nenhamba kuti mhedziso inochinja sei zvichienderana nemamiriro.
z-m-08-06.material: Kusunga kamwe kutenderedza bhokisi rose, unoda tambo yeanenge 4 m zvishoma (inokwana chaizvo). Une maribhoni maviri: ribhoni tsvuku re 2.4 m neribhoni bhuruu re 1.65 m. Unoda kubatanidza maribhoni maviri kuita rimwe. Hausati wasarudza kana uchavabatanidza 'nekuisa miganhu yavo pamwe chete uye kuvanamatidza netepi' kana 'nekuvhara miganhu yavo uye kuvanamatidza negamu'.
z-m-08-06.thinking.2: Kutaura nenhamba mhedziso inochinja zvichienderana nemamiriro
z-m-08-06.prereq.1: Kuziva kuti 1 m = 100 cm nekushandura mayuniti ehurefu
z-m-08-06.s.s1.prompt: Neruzivo rwunozivikanwa pari zvino chete, tinogona kutaura kuti ribhoni iri rinogona kusunga bhokisi here?
z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.0: Funga nzira mbiri chaidzo dzekubatanidza maribhoni maviri, uye unyore hurefu hwese hwenzira imwe neimwe.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora kuti fungidziro ipi nezvemaitiro ekubatanidza maribhoni inodiwa kuti chirevo chiicho chive chakarurama.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.a: Hatigone kuziva. Tinofanira kuziva kuti ribhoni ripi rinomonerwa kutanga
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.a: Kurongeka kwekumonera maribhoni hakukanganisi hurefu hwese. Tsvaga ruzivo runokanganisa hurefu.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.b: Hatigone kuziva. Zvinoenderana nemaitiro avanobatanidzwa nawo, saka tinofanira kuziva zvakawanda
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakaratidza kuti kuti pane hurefu hunovharwa here kunoenderana nemaitiro avanobatanidzwa nawo.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.c: Tinogona kusunga. 2.4 + 1.65 = 4.05, iyo i hombe kupfuura 4
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.c: Kuwedzera hurefu hwemaribhoni maviri kwakanaka kusvika pano. Asi huwandu uhwu hunoramba sezvahwuri here, zvichienderana nemaitiro avanobatanidzwa nawo?
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.d: Hatigone kusunga. 1.65 i pfupi kupfuura 2.4, saka haipi 4

z-m-08-01.title: Tafura yekuverenga ya Minjae yehuwandu hwemapeji emabhuku 23
z-m-08-01.topic: Place value pakuwedzera nhamba ine madhijiti matatu nenhamba ine madhijiti maviri
z-m-08-01.goal: Tsvaga mutsara mutafura ye column-multiplication umo place value yakatadza, tarisa mhinduro nekufanofungidzira nekushandisa dhijiti rekupedzisira, uye wozoinyora zvakare zvakarurama.
z-m-08-01.material: Muchinyorwa, mabhuku enyaya 23 ane mapeji 346 rimwe nerimwe akatengwa. Minjae akashandisa column multiplication kutsvaga huwandu hwose hwemapeji. Hapana pikicha, saka tafura yekuverenga yaMinjae yakanyorwa nemashoko, mutsara nemutsara.
z-m-08-01.thinking.1: Kutarisa mhedzisiro nekufanofungidzira nekushandisa dhijiti rekupedzisira
z-m-08-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga tafura ye column-multiplication nekuziva makosha e ones, tens, ne hundreds places (nhanho yeGrade 4)
z-m-08-01.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa saizi yemhedzisiro yekuverenga nekukosha kwakafanofungidzirwa
z-m-08-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga mutafura yekuverenga yaMinjae unotadza.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe, nyora nemashoko kuti multiplier ine kukosha kupi (dhijiti 2 riri pa place ipi).
z-m-08-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira zvakapoteredza mapeji mangani emabhuku 20 e346 mapeji aizova, uye uienzanise ne1730.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.0: Nyora 23 pazasi pe346, uye utange nekuwedzera ne3 iri pa ones place.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.1: Nyora 346 × 3 = 1038, yakarongwa kubva pa ones place.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.2: Wedzerawo ne2 iri pa tens place. Nyora 346 × 2 = 692, nemagumo ayo ekurudyi akarongwa pasi pe1038.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.explain: Zvakatanga kutadza pamutsara 3. 2 mu 23 iri pa tens place, saka inoreva 20, kwete 2. Saka 346 × 2 = 692 inofanira kunyorwa nzvimbo imwe kuruboshwe (692 inofanira kuverengwa se 6920). Kuwedzera kwemutsara 4, 1038 + 692 = 1730, kwakarurama pachako, asi nhamba mbiri dzinowedzerwa dzakashata, uye mhinduro yemutsara 5 ndiyo mhedzisiro yezvo.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvikonzero zvose zvinokubvumira kuziva kuti mapeji 1730 akashata pasina kupedza kuverenga.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wafungidzira zvakapoteredza kuti mabhuku 23 ane nguva dzingani mapeji ebhuku rimwe.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pasina kuverenga, tonga kana sarudzo imwe neimwe iri yechokwadi kana yenhema, wozotarisa kana sarudzo dzechokwadi dzichipokana ne1730.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.a: 346 yakawanda kupfuura 300 uye 23 yakawanda kupfuura 20, saka product inofanira kuva yakawanda kupfuura 6000
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.b: 346 ne23 zvose ndema even, saka product inofanira kuva even, asi 1730 ndi odd
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.b: 23 ndi odd uye 1730 ndi even. Kana uchitaura nezve even ne odd, tanga watarisa nhamba mbiri dzaiverengwa chaizvo.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.c: Sezvo 6 × 3 = 18, dhijiti rekupedzisira re product rinofanira kuva 8, asi 1730 inopera ne0
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.c: Kuwedzera ma ones digits kutarisa dhijiti rekupedzisira nzira yekutarisa yakanakawo.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.d: Sezvo 692 iri pasi pe 1038, huwandu 1730 hunofanira kuva pasi pe 1038
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.d: Kuwedzera nhamba mbiri kunopa mhedzisiro yakakura kupfuura imwe neimwe. Tarisazve kuti huwandu hunoenzaniswa sei neimwe yenhamba mbiri.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.e: Bhuku rimwe nerimwe rine mapeji 346 uye pane mabhuku 23, saka mhinduro inofanira kuva pamusoro pe 346, uye 1730 iri pamusoro pe 346
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.e: Chokwadi kuti 1730 iri pamusoro pe 346. Asi izvozvo oga hazvioneshi kuti 1730 yakanganisa. Unofanira kufungidzira hukuru hwakakodzera zvikuru.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.explain: Kufungidzira 300 × 20 = 6000, mhinduro inofanira kuva pamusoro pemapeji 6000, uye kubva pakuwanza mamwe manhamba, 6 × 3 = 18, nhamba yekupedzisira inofanira kuva 8. Chikonzero chimwe nechimwe hachikodzeri 1730. Chikonzero che even/odd (b) chakanganisa nokuti 23 isanhamba yakaenzana kwete, uye d ne e hazvisi humbowo hwokuti 1730 yakanganisa.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare tafura yokuverenga yaMinjae utsvage huwandu hwakarurama hwemapeji. Nyorawo nemashoko ako kuti sei mutsetse wawakachinja unofanira kuchinjwa nenzira iyoyo.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti nhamba 2 iri panzvimbo yemakumi inomirira kukosha kupi.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora padivi mhedzisiro ye 346 × 2 ne 346 × 20, uye uenzanise kuti ndeipi yakakodzera mutsetse wakarurama.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here kuti sei nhamba inowanzwa na 346 mukuverenga kwako kwakaruramiswa iri 20 (kana kukosha kwakaita se 6920) panzvimbo ye 2?
z-m-08-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here, nokufungidzira kana nokushandisa nhamba yokupedzisira, kuti nzira yawakashandisa (kuwedzera 0, kufambisa nzvimbo imwe kuruboshwe, kuwanza na 20) inowirirana nemapeji 7958?
z-m-08-01.s.s3.model.0: 346 × 20 = 6920. 2 iri panzvimbo yemakumi i 20, saka unofanira kunyora 6920, kwete 692. 1038 + 6920 = mapeji 7958.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.model.1: Fambisa 692 nzvimbo imwe kuruboshwe. Kana ukawanza nenhamba iri panzvimbo yemakumi, nzvimbo yeshanu iri yakasununguka, saka unofanira kufunga kuti ine 0 ipapo. 1038 + 6920 = 7958, saka mapeji 7958.

z-m-08-03.title: Kuisa 14 mubhokisi rimwe nerimwe kuti zvidimbu zvinosara zvive nhamba isina kuenzana
z-m-08-03.goal: Dzidza muganho wekukosha kwunogona kutorwa nechasara, gadzira mienzaniso yakasiyana yechinoparadzaniswa, chikamu, nechasara zvinosangana nemamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti sei muganho uri nomutowo uyu.
z-m-08-03.material: Chigadziko chechokoreti chinoisa chokoreti 14 chaizvo mubhokisi rimwe nerimwe. Mabhokisi azara chete ndiwo anoverengwa, uye zvidimbu zvisina kuzara zvisingagoni kuzadza bhokisi hazviiswi mubhokisi asi zvinochengetwa padivi. Rondedza huwandu hwechokoreti hwakaitwa se a, huwandu hwemabhokisi azara se q, uye huwandu hwezvidimbu zvakachengetwa padivi se r. (a iri pakati pe 100 ne 999.)
z-m-08-03.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa mamiriro anogoneka kubva kune asingagoneki
z-m-08-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso inosangana nemamiriro akati wandei panguva imwe chete
z-m-08-03.prereq.1: Kuziva hukama hwokuti muparadzanisi × chikamu + chasara = chinoparadzaniswa
z-m-08-03.s.s1.prompt: Chokoreti dzinoiswa 14 mubhokisi rimwe, uye pane chidimbu 1 kana kupfuura chakasara. Sarudza nhamba dzose dzinogona kuva huwandu hwezvidimbu zvakasara r.

z-m-08-03.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo yega yega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kuti zvidimbu zvakasara zvaigona kuzadza rimwe bhokisi here.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.a: Kana zvidimbu 14 zvasara, unogona kuisa zvidimbu 14 izvozvo mubhokisi rimwe. Huwandu hwemabhokisi hunova sei ipapo?
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga nezvemamiriro umo zvidimbu zvidiki pa 14 zvasara.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.c: Kana zvidimbu 17 zvasara, unogona kuzadza rimwe bhokisi. Zvinosara zvangani ipapo? Funga zvakare kuti zvingasara zvakawanda zvakadini.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.d: Iri ndiro mamiriro umo chidimbu chimwe chete chashaikwa kuti bhokisi razadzwe.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.e: Kana zvidimbu 28 zvasara, unogona kuzadza mamwe mabhokisi maviri. Funga zvakare nezvomuganho wechasara.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.f: Wakawana mamiriro umo zvidiki pa 14 zvasara.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.explain: Mabhokisi azara chete ndiwo anoverengwa, saka kana zvidimbu 14 kana kupfuura zvakasara, unogona kuzadza mamwe mabhokisi. Saka chasara chinogona kuva kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 13 chete. 5, 13, ne 9 zvinogoneka, uye 14, 17, ne 28 hazvigoneki.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mamiriro matatu akasiyana umo huwandu hwechokoreti a, huwandu hwemabhokisi azara q, uye huwandu hwezvidimbu zvakasara r zvose zvinotevera mamiriro aya. Mamiriro: huwandu hwemabhokisi ndi 10 kana kupfuura uye 99 kana shoma, uye huwandu hwezvidimbu zvakasara hwakaenzana kwete.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza huwandu hwemabhokisi q, wobva watsvaga kuti chokoreti dzingani dzakaiswa mu q mabhokisi e 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera huwandu husina kuenzana hwezvidimbu zvakasara kuti uite a, wobva watarisa kuti zvidimbu zvakasara zvidiki pa 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwechokoreti huri pakati pe 100 ne 999.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwechokoreti dzakaitwa hunofanira kuva pakati pe 100 ne 999.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Huwandu hwemabhokisi ndi 10 kana kupfuura uye 99 kana shoma.

z-m-08-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, 14 × 12 + 5 = 173, saka chokoreti 173 dzinozadza mabhokisi 12 nezvidimbu 5 zvakasara. 14 × 25 + 9 = 359, 14 × 40 + 13 = 573, ne 14 × 71 + 1 = 995 zvinosanganawo nemamiriro. Kana ukanyora chokoreti 188 semabhokisi 12 nezvidimbu 20 zvakasara, huwandu hwakarurama, asi hwakanganisa nokuti zvidimbu 20 zvakasara zvinogona kuzadza rimwe bhokisi.

z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora kuti q ne r zvinochinja sei wakaita izvozvo.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Chikonzero chako chinobatana nezvinoitika kana 14 kana kupfuura zvasara (kuzadza mamwe mabhokisi) here?
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti r iri pasi pe 14 mumienzaniso yako yose mitatu?
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana zvidimbu 14 kana kupfuura zvakasara, unogona kuzadza rimwe bhokisi. Ipapo huwandu hwemabhokisi hunokwira nomumwe uye chasara chinodzikira. Saka chasara chinofanira kuva chishoma pa 14.

z-m-08-05.title: Hurefu hwakasara mushure mekushandisa 3.47 m kubva paribhoni re 10 m
z-m-08-05.topic: Kuenzanisa nzira dzekubvisa nhamba ine decimal places 2 kubva panhamba yakazara
z-m-08-05.goal: Enzanisa nzira dzakati wandei dzekugadzirisa dambudziko rimwechete kusarudza dzakarurama, shandisa kufungidzira kusefa mhinduro dzakaipa, uye utaure kuti nzira ipi inokodzera nhamba idzi, nechikonzero.
z-m-08-05.material:
Paribhoni re 10 m kureba, 3.47 m yakachekwa uye yakashandiswa. Shamwari shanu dzakawana hurefu hweribhoni rakasara seizvi.
Mina: Bvisa 3 kubva ku 10 kuwana 7, wobva wanamatidza chikamu che decimal 0.47 sezvarakaita, saka 7.47 m.
Jiho: Nyora 10 se 10.00, rongedza ma decimal points, uye ubvise nemakoramu kuwana 6.53 m.
Haneul: Chinja 3.47 kuita 3.5 uye ubvise kuwana 6.5 m chaizvo.
Raon: Ona 10 se 1000/100 uye 3.47 se 347/100 kuwana 653/100, iyo i 6.53 m.
Soyeon: Bvisa 3 kubva ku 10 kuita 7, wobva wabvisa 0.47 yakawanda kubva ku 7 kuwana 6.53 m.
z-m-08-05.thinking.1: Kutarisa kana mhinduro ine musoro nekufungidzira
z-m-08-05.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa nzira, kusarudza imwe, uye kutaura rini inokodzera
z-m-08-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva nhamba ine decimal places 2 nekurongedza ma decimal points
z-m-08-05.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pema fractions ane denominator 100 nema decimals (padanho regiredhi re4)
z-m-08-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzese dzinowana hurefu chaihwo hweribhoni rakasara zvakarurama.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera nzira yeshamwari imwe neimwe uye unyore kuti chii chinoitika ku 3.47 painobviswa kubva ku 10.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana nzira inoti inowana mutengo chaiwo yakachinja kana kusiya nhamba ipi neipi.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.a: Kana ukanamatidza chikamu che decimal sezvachakaita, wakabvisa 3 yakubva ku 3.47 chete. Tarisa zvakare zvakaitwa ne 0.47.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i nzira inorongedza ma decimal points uye inobvisa madhijiti panzvimbo dzakafanana.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.c: Kuchinja 3.47 kuita 3.5 kunochinja mutengo. Kufungidzira hakusi nzira yekuwana mutengo chaiwo.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i nzira inoshandisa denominator imwechete uye inobvisa ma numerators.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.e: Iyi i nzira inopatsanura kubvisa kuita matanho maviri.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.explain: Nzira dzaJiho, Raon, naSoyeon dzose dzinowana 6.53 m chaizvo. Mina haana kubvisa 0.47 asi akaiwedzera, saka akawana 7.47, uye Haneul akachinja 3.47 kuita 3.5, saka akawana 6.5, iyo isiri mutengo chaiwo. Nzira yaHaneul inogona kushandiswa kufungidzira.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.prompt: Chikonzero chakanakisa chaunogona kutaura, usina kupedza kuverenga, kuti mhinduro yaMina 7.47 m yakaipa i chii?
z-m-08-05.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti ndeipi iri diki: 10 kubvisa 3, kana 10 kubvisa 3.47.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, taura kana chirevo icho i humbowo hwekuti 7.47 yakaipa kana kungotaura chokwadi chete.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.a: Chikamu che decimal chemhinduro chine madhijiti maviri, saka i chinoshamisa semhedzisiro
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.a: Nhamba ine decimal places 2 inogona kuva mhinduro. Huwandu hwe decimal places hahusi hwaro hwekutonga kuti chinhu chakaipa.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.b: Mhinduro 7.47 i yakakura kupfuura nhamba inobviswa, 3.47, saka inoshamisa
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.b: Zvechokwadi kuti 7.47 i yakakura kupfuura 3.47, asi ichocho hachisi chikonzero chekuti yakaipa.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.c: Unobvisa nhamba hombe kupfuura 3 kubva ku 10, asi mhinduro i hombe kupfuura 7
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.c: Uku i kufungidzira kwekuti sezvo 3.47 i hombe kupfuura 3, hurefu hwakasara hunofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 7.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.d: Mhinduro ine decimal point haigone kuva mhedzisiro yekubvisa kwemhando iyi
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.d: Mukubvisa ne decimals, mhinduro ine decimal point i yakajairika.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.explain: Wakabvisa 3.47, iri hombe kupfuura 3, kubva ku 10, saka hurefu hwakasara hunofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 7. 7.47 yaMina i hombe kupfuura 7, saka unogona kuziva kuti inoshamisa usina kupedza kuverenga.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.prompt: Pakati penzira nhatu dzinowana mhinduro chaiyo (Jiho, Raon, Soyeon), sarudza yaunofunga kuti inokodzera zvikuru kuverenga uku uye unyore chikonzero chako. Wedzera mutsetse mumwe wekuti nhamba dzaifanira kuchinja sei kuti imwe nzira ikodzere zvirinani.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.hint.0: Edza nzira nhatu iwe pachako uye umake iri nyore kukanganisira.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti nzira imwe neimwe yaizochinja sei kana nhamba inobviswa yaiva 3.472 kana 3.4.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa kuti nzira yawakasarudza inopa 6.53 m chaizvo here?
z-m-08-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga kana nzira yawakasarudza ichiramba ichibatsira kana nhamba dzachinja (semuenzaniso, 3.472, kana 100 panzvimbo ye 10) here?
z-m-08-05.s.s3.model.0: Ndinonzwa kubvisa kwemakoramu kwaJiho kuri nyore. Kana ukanyora 10 se 10.00, ma decimal points anorongeka, saka unokanganisa zvishoma. Asi kana nhamba i pfupi sa 3.4, kuipatsanura kuita matanho maviri sa Soyeon kunogona kukurumidza.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.model.1: Nzira yaSoyeon i nyore. Unobvisa 3 kubva ku 10 kuita 7 wobva wabvisa 0.47, saka unogona kuita mundangariro. Kana nhamba dzakaoma, kubvisa kwemakoramu kunoratidzika kuchengetedza zvakawanda.

z-m-08-08.title: Hukuru hwechikamu chine ruvara pa 100-square grid
z-m-08-08.topic: Nhamba dzine decimal places 2 dzinoonekwa pa 100-square grid
z-m-08-08.goal: Tora 100-square grid se 1, nyora huwandu hwemasikweya se nhamba ine decimal places 2, uye ugadzire iwe pachako hukuru hwakati wandei hunowira pakati pema decimals maviri.
z-m-08-08.material: Pane pepa re grid rine masikweya 10 mukati nemasikweya 10 pasi, masikweya 100 ese. Taura kuti hukuru hwepepa rese re grid i 1. Ipapo sikweya imwe i 0.01. Unoisa ruvara pamasikweya pa grid iyi netsvuku nebhuruu, uchishandisa ruvara rumwe chete pasikweya imwe neimwe uye usingaisi ruvara pasikweya imwechete kaviri.
z-m-08-08.thinking.0: Kunzwisisa kuti grid nema decimals zvinoenderana sei
z-m-08-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira hukuru hunogutsa mamiriro akati wandei panguva imwechete
z-m-08-08.thinking.2: Kutsanangura range yehukuru uchishandisa ma decimals
z-m-08-08.prereq.0: Ma fractions ane denominator 100 nenhamba dzine decimal places 2
z-m-08-08.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwema decimals (padanho regiredhi re4)
z-m-08-08.s.s1.prompt: Masikweya 25 akaiswa ruvara rutsvuku. Tsananguro ipi yehukuru hwechikamu ichi i yakarurama?
z-m-08-08.s.s1.hint.0: Uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti girid yose i100 masquare uye mutsara mumwe i10 masquare, tanga wanyora kuti mutsara mumwe ndechikamu chipi chehuwandu hwose.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.hint.1: Wana kuti 0.3 i masquare mangani kana yakanyorwa se0.30, wobva waienzanisa ne25 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.a: 25 masquare i0.025, nokuti square rimwe i0.001
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.a: Huwandu hwose i100 masquare, saka square rimwe i 1 yakagoverwa ne100. 0.001 isquare rimwe kana huwandu hwose hwakagoverwa kuita masquare 1000.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.b: 25 masquare i0.25 uye yakakura kupfuura 0.3, nokuti 25 yakakura kupfuura 3
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.b: 0.3 inogona kunyorwa se0.30. Usaenzanise nhamba 25 ne3 sezvadziri; enzanisa nzvimbo dzakafanana.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.c: 25 masquare i0.25 uye idiki kupfuura 0.3. 0.3 i30 masquare
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandura nhamba ine nzvimbo imwe yedhesimali 0.3 kuita nhamba ine nzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali ukaibatanidza nenhamba yemasquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.d: Mutsara mumwe (10 masquare) haisi 1 yehuwandu hwose asi 0.1. Huwandu hwose i100 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwose i100 masquare, saka square rimwe i0.01 uye 25 masquare i0.25. 0.3 i0.30, inova 30 masquare, saka 25 masquare idiki kupfuura 0.3.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.prompt: Ruvara r masquare matsvuku ne b masquare ebhuruu. Mamiriro: ruvara chikamu chitsvuku chive chikuru kupfuura 0.2 uye chidiki kupfuura 0.3, uye chikamu chebhuruu chive chikuru kupfuura 0.05 uye chidiki kupfuura 0.1. Zvakare, huwandu hwose hwemasquare akavharwa ruvara (r + b) hunofanira kuva odd, uye huwandu hwose hunofanira kuva hukuru kupfuura 0.3 uye hudiki kupfuura 0.4. Gadzira nhamba nhatu dzakasiyana dzemasquare dzinokodzera mamiriro. (Kana huwandu hwose hwemasquare akavharwa ruvara hwakasiyana, hunoverengwa senyaya yakasiyana.)
z-m-08-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora chiyero chemasquare mangani aunogona kuvhara ruvara rutsvuku nemasquare mangani ebhuruu, imwe neimwe senhamba yemasquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba imwe yetsvuku nenhamba imwe yebhuruu, uvawedzere, uye uongorore kuti huwandu inhamba odd pakati pe31 ne39 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Chikamu chitsvuku chikuru kupfuura 0.2 uye chidiki kupfuura 0.3.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvuku inofanira kuva pakati pe21 ne29 masquare. 0.2 i20 masquare uye 0.3 i30 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Chikamu chebhuruu chikuru kupfuura 0.05 uye chidiki kupfuura 0.1.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Bhuruu inofanira kuva pakati pe6 ne9 masquare. 0.05 i5 masquare uye 0.1 i10 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c4: Chikamu chose chakavharwa ruvara chikuru kupfuura 0.3 uye chidiki kupfuura 0.4.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c4: Huwandu hwemasquare etsvuku nebhuruu hauzi pakati pe31 ne39 masquare.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c5: Huwandu hwose hwemasquare akavharwa ruvara hwuri odd.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.explain: (25, 8) i33 masquare, inova 0.33; (22, 9) i31 masquare, inova 0.31; (28, 9) i37 masquare, inova 0.37; uye (29, 6) i35 masquare, inova 0.35. Huwandu hunogoneka ina: 31, 33, 35, ne37 masquare, uye zvose zvinhamba odd dzemasquare pakati pe0.30 ne0.40 (39 masquare haigoni kugadzirwa, nokuti kunyange tsvuku 29 masquare nebhuruu 9 masquare zvinowedzera kuita 38 chete). Kana ukagadzira huwandu hwakafanana ne r ne b dzakasiyana, huverenge senyaya imwe chete.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe yenyaya dzawakagadzira, nyora huwandu hwose hwemasquare akavharwa ruvara sedhesimali, uye unyore kuti nei yakakura kupfuura 0.3 uye iri diki kupfuura 0.4.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwose hwemasquare hwaunowana nekuwedzera r ne b munyaya yawakasarudza, uye unyore dhesimali raunowana nekugovanisa nhamba iyoyo ne100.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chinja 0.3 ne0.4 imwe neimwe kuita nhamba yemasquare uye uvaenzanise padivi nedivi.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Tsvuku ... masquare + bhuruu ... masquare = ... masquare, saka ...
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Huwandu hwose hwemasquare munyaya yawakasarudza huri odd chaizvo uye huri pakati pe31 ne39 masquare here?
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakashandura 0.3 ne0.4 kuita nhamba dzemasquare padhirodhi (30 masquare, 40 masquare) ukavaenzanisa here?
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Tsvuku 25 masquare nebhuruu 8 masquare zvinoita 33 masquare, saka i0.33. 0.3 i0.30, inova 30 masquare, uye 0.4 i40 masquare, uye 33 masquare iri pakati pazvo.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.model.1: 28 + 9 = 37 masquare, saka i0.37. 0.37 yakakura kupfuura 0.30 uye idiki kupfuura 0.40. Nokuti inopfuura 30 masquare uye iri pasi pe40 masquare.
